Things comparison reference

Earlier newsletter.png and testimonials.png artwork was from Cultured Code.
Source: https://culturedcode.com/things/

The current newsletter.png and testimonials.png are independently constructed
project artwork covered by the repository MIT license. Their dimensions remain
128 x 128 pixels. Current hashes and the historical source URLs and hashes are
recorded separately in assets/sources.json.

Original Things artwork is retained outside the distribution for comparison
only. It is not covered by the design-tokens MIT license. Copyright and
applicable terms remain with Cultured Code. This notice grants no reuse rights.
